security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; frame-src llembas-sealed: http://llembas-sealed.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: The LLeMbas agent on this computer, and your server's chats
bundle.longDescription: LLeMbas Desktop runs the LLeMbas CLI agent on this computer, so agent chats can work in your projects here without a terminal, and shows them, and the chats on your LLeMbas 2.0 server, in an app of its own: the agent's working directory and the server's files side by side, and a viewer for what the agent shows you.
